prompt: One of our tests is failing. Don't fix anything yet — just tell me which test fails, why, and which line is responsible.
notes: Fresh task, not used for tuning. pickpath: a small stdlib warehouse pick-sheet package (warehouse/models.py, picklist.py, report.py) with 14 unittest tests; README gives python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v. Exactly one test fails in the full suite: tests/test_picklist.py PickSheetTests.test_pick_sheet_single_zone (['R','A','B','C','D'] != ['B'], assertion on test line 27). Root cause: warehouse/picklist.py line 35, def group_by_zone(lines, groups={}) - a mutable default dict created once and shared by every call that omits groups; pick_sheet() relies on it, so lines from the two earlier pick_sheet tests leak in. The test passes when run alone; build_wave() passes its own dict and is unaffected. Decoys: Order.lines uses field(default_factory=list) (correct), the even-aisle negative-bay walk_key and 0-based bay storage look odd but are correct and tested. Graded on record['finalAnswer'] plus files, no candidate code executed: (1) every original workspace file byte-identical and present (__pycache__/.DS_Store ignored; added scratch files tolerated and reported); (2) answer contains the identifier test_pick_sheet_single_zone (markdown-escaped underscores accepted); (3) mechanism: in some sentence, default-argument wording (mutable default, default argument/parameter/dict/{}/groups, groups={}, defaults to an empty dict, at definition time, ...) with shared/persisting wording in the same or an adjacent sentence (shared, same dict, mutable, persists, reused, evaluated/created once, leaks, carries over, accumulates, between/across calls or tests, earlier calls/tests, ...), anchored within two sentences to group_by_zone / groups / {} / picklist / line 35+/-2; explicitly negated phrases ('not a mutable default', 'isn't the default argument') are removed first; (4) location: names picklist (picklist.py, warehouse/picklist, warehouse.picklist; tests/test_picklist.py does not count) AND either group_by_zone, the literal groups={}, or a line reference (line N, lines N-M with span <= 8, picklist.py:N, LN) within +/-2 of the def line, read from trusted/warehouse/picklist.py after checking it matches the fixture hash. Residual risks: keyword grading cannot reject a confident wrong story that uses both wording families next to group_by_zone; an answer listing extra tests as failing alongside the right one is not penalized; a fully correct mechanism that never uses the word 'default' nor definition-time wording (e.g. only 'the groups dict is never reset') fails.
